At most18 applies only to standard18-joint caller data; generic helper does not enforce18labels. Godot int(D*1000) truncates toward zero and its wrapper keeps those integers. z_index draw order is separate from public optional0..255 camera-nearness depth. Identical xy projections do not imply identical depth/order.

source_contract.title: Palette exemplar packing
inputs_and_units: Lua table packed-pixel/Color keys with numeric counts
source_contract.algorithm_and_conditions: For each output pixel iterate pairs; select positive-valued key, draw it, decrement count, immediately remove key. Therefore each key is sampled at most once; counts are not preserved. Limit4096 keys; pairs order unspecified.
source_contract.outputs_and_mutation: 64x64 exemplar Image; destructively empties selected input keys.
source_contract.failure_and_state_branches: More4096 distinct keys truncate; type conversion/Color key identity is host-dependent; empty keys leave transparent pixels.
remaining_blockers: Reproduction requiring byte-identical order needs Lua pairs and exact host color conversion
